metadata.notes: HMT-2 real-money checkpoint (CORRECTED). SCHEDULED_EVENT deterministically reselected (~20 per class, spread across years) from the now-complete v2 event snapshot, routed around PROTECTED_HOLDOUT. PROTECTED_HOLDOUT/RANDOM_DEVELOPMENT preserve v1's exact sessions with near-zero churn — replacement occurs ONLY for genuine session-invalidity (holdout) or genuine session-invalidity/now-a-selected-event-session (random-development); NEVER for a mere classification collision. HIGH_VOL_NON_EVENT/COMPRESSION are computed from the real, retained GC.v.0 ohlcv-1h reference series: a raw per-year top/bottom-20% candidate POOL is first excluded of everything claimed by strata 1-4, then reduced to a final ~70-session, year-stratified sample via Hamilton (largest-remainder) allocation plus a deterministic domain-separated seeded draw (never by log-range magnitude) — see corpus-selection-manifest-v2-allocation-evidence.json for the full allocation tables and seed digests, and stderr output / WO final report for exactly which RANDOM_DEVELOPMENT/PROTECTED_HOLDOUT sessions changed and why. Precedence order for v2 (see corpus_selection_v2 module docstring): PROTECTED_HOLDOUT > SCHEDULED_EVENT > RANDOM_DEVELOPMENT > MATCHED_CONTROL > HIGH_VOL_NON_EVENT > COMPRESSION — RANDOM_DEVELOPMENT is HIGHER precedence than MATCHED_CONTROL/HIGH_VOL_NON_EVENT/COMPRESSION in v2, unlike v1.
